items.q: Do I need prior experience to join?
items.a: No. Our tracks are designed for motivated beginners. We select based on curiosity and commitment, not your CV.

items.q: How much time does it take each week?
items.a: Plan for around 10–15 hours per week: two evenings together with your cohort plus self-paced learning between sessions.

items.q: What language is the program in?
items.a: Learning materials are mostly in English. Mentoring and community events run in both English and German.

items.q: Do I have to be in Düsseldorf?
items.a: Our local chapter is based in Düsseldorf. Remote participation is possible, though most graduates tell us the local community is what makes it work.
You finish with a portfolio project, a community of peers, and access to our partner network for job introductions and mentorship.

storySection.title: How It Started
storySection.hook: In 2018, a group of students in Münster asked a simple question: why does learning tech skills have to cost thousands of euros?
storySection.body:
They couldn't find a good answer. So they built TechLabs — a volunteer-run program where anyone with motivation could learn web development, data science, or AI, completely free. No entrance exams, no tuition, no income-share agreements. Just a community of people helping each other grow.

What started as a single cohort of 40 learners has become a movement across eight European cities. Over 2,500 Digital Shapers have graduated. The mentors are still volunteers. The program is still free. And the question that started it all still drives everything we do.

quote.text: I'd been rejected from three paid bootcamps I couldn't afford. TechLabs didn't ask for my bank statement — they asked what I wanted to build.
quote.name: Lena S.
quote.role: Digital Shaper, Batch #3 — now Junior Developer at SAP

faq.title: Partnership FAQs
faq.subtitle: Common questions about partnering with TechLabs.

items.q: What types of partnerships do you offer?
items.a: We offer two main models: Event Partnerships, where you co-create workshops and events with our students, and Branding Sponsorships, where your brand gains visibility across our network. Both can be customized to fit your goals.
Partnerships are flexible and can range from a single event to a full semester engagement. We work with you to find the right level of involvement that matches your capacity and goals.

You define the topic and framework in coordination with TechLabs. We handle organization, outreach, and logistics. Your team leads the workshop with tech-enthusiastic students eager to learn from industry experts.

items.q: Can we expand our partnership to other locations?
items.a: Absolutely! TechLabs operates in 16 locations across 8 European countries. Partnerships can start locally and scale to additional cities based on your reach and objectives.

items.q: What kind of students will we work with?
items.a: Our participants come from STEM and business backgrounds, with 46% female representation. They are pre-selected, motivated individuals learning Data Science, AI, Web Development, and UX Design.
Simply reach out through our contact form or email us. We'll schedule an introductory call to understand your goals and propose a tailored partnership model.
